StageAttention: ['Names in place of memories, blades in place of embraces. Nothing more than a ghost of the past.', '"Ezette" rushes toward the player, leaps into the air to charge up, then swiftly swings the greatsword at the target.', '"Ezette" dodges the target\'s attack, enters Anti-Matrix, and quickly counterattacks.', '"Ezette" drives the greatsword into the ground and channels energy into it. Once fully charged, "Ezette" dashes at the target with a slash, and the weapon enters a permanent enhanced state.', '"Ezette" charges up briefly, then unleashes a spinning slash, dealing heavy AoE DMG.', '"Ezette" licks the blade, then launches continuous slashes at the target. This attack can be parried. After slashing multiple times, "Ezette" converts the blade into a mechanical claw to grab the target.', '"Ezette" quickly moves near the target and delivers a powerful slash.', '"Ezette" charges up, leaps high into the air, then slams down near the target, dealing AoE DMG.', '"Ezette" lets out a roar and unleashes a rapid series of slashes on the target. "Ezette" then turns and retreats before rushing at the target again with two follow-up slashes.', '"Ezette" dives underground, ambushes the target, then bursts up, leaps into the air, and plummets down for a crushing blow.']
StageAttentionTitle: ['"Ezette"', 'Blind Repulsion', 'Nightmare Reversal', 'Assault Surge', 'Annihilating Crush', 'Wound Lick', 'Shadow Pursuit', 'Voidburial', 'Defiled Memory', 'Buried Heart']
